No EC5 target-context finding: implementer declared `Repo: DontPanic`, `Env: dev`, `Project: (none)`, and `target_context.commands_run` is empty, so no forbidden command shapes. Baseline checked: `architecture_html.render_html(snapshot: dict[str, Any]) -> str`; CSS vars are `--bg`, `--bg-panel`, `--fg`, `--fg-muted`, `--accent`, `--accent-2`, `--good`, `--warn`, `--bad`, `--border`.

FINDING (high, security): `fix_url` allows active `javascript:` href injection despite the “no injection” acceptance. Evidence: `report_html.py:467-468` and `:520-521` escape the string but still render `href="javascript:alert(3)"`; my direct renderer probe printed that exact href. Recommendation: validate/sanitize URL schemes before rendering links, e.g. allow only `http`, `https`, or render unsafe URLs as inert escaped text, and add a regression test for `javascript:`.

FINDING (medium, correctness): `_validate_smoke_payload` does not type-check the F003 smoke envelope fields that drive report semantics. Evidence: `report_html.py:181-208` only requires `schema_version`, `supervisor_surfaces`, surface `name`, and `status`; `_compute_verdict` reads unvalidated `smoke.exit_code` at `:288`, and a smoke payload with `"exit_code": "2"` rendered a `verdict-ready` chip instead of rejecting the malformed payload or blocking. Recommendation: validate F003 schema-required fields, especially `exit_code` int `0|1|2`, top-level `el
